children: W.A.G payment solutions plc announces that Morgan Seigler has resigned as a non-executive director of the Company with effect from 23 October 2026.

Morgan was appointed to the Board as the designated representative of TA Associates Management L.P. ('TA Associates'). Following TA Associates' disposal of its shareholding in the Company on 23 October 2026, Morgan has stepped down from the Board.

Morgan has been a steadfast supporter of Eurowag for more than ten years, and has served on the Board since the Company's IPO in 2021. His rigorous challenge has strengthened the business and contributed directly to Eurowag's success. The Board thanks Morgan for his valued contribution to the Company.

Eurowag was founded in 1995 and is a leading technology company and an important partner to Europe's commercial road transport industry, with a purpose to make it clean, fair and efficient. Eurowag enables trucking companies to successfully transition to a low carbon, digital future by harnessing all mission critical data, insights and payment and financing transactions into a single ecosystem and connects their operations seamless before a journey, on the road and post-delivery. Eurowag is listed on the London Stock Exchange
and is a constituent of the FTSE 250. Investors - Eurowag (LSE: EWG)
